meta.name: Shehar Lakhot
meta.description: A man who, against his will, goes back to his hometown, where he is forced to face his history and prove his innocence.

videos.title: You shouldn't have come back, Dev
videos.overview: Dev has a reluctant homecoming after 10 long years . Between trying to stop a protest blocking a mine and stumbling onto a blackmailing plot, he also has to confront his past in an unwelcome world.

videos.title: Where's my car?
videos.overview: Dev is forced to team up with the diabolical twins to find RP's car. Kairav is involved in a larger game that he has no intention of losing. Pallavi investigates the foreigner’s murder despite Rajbir telling her to close the file.

videos.title: A little this, a little that
videos.overview: While the family copes with a devastating loss, a violent riot helps bring Dev and Sandhya back together. Kairav is desprate as Rajbir and Bhenno go rogue. Dev is accused of murder and has to prove his innocence.

videos.title: One last surprise, Mr. Tomar?
videos.overview: Dev grapples with the charges against him while dealing with his father’s illness. Rajbir finds out about Kairav’s illegal business and gets ready to tighten the noose. Dev discovers Sandhya’s secret and is devastated.

videos.title: Careful, anything can happen
videos.overview: Dev tries to make amends with his father. Rajbir and Bhenno try to side-line Kairav. Vikas faces pressure from Kairav to call off the protest. Dev and Vidushi discover Jay was involved in illegal activities for Kairav.

videos.title: It's all beyond me
videos.overview: Dev has a surprise visitor who won’t take no for an answer. Dev and Antariksh discover shocking evidence from Kairav’s hotel. Bhi and Bho chase a ghost which leads to devastating consequences for both.

videos.title: The roles are a bit different now
videos.overview: Dev discovers a vital key to his innocence. Sandhya’s past actions threaten to catch up with her. Rajbir forms an alliance with Kairav and betrays Bhenno. Sandhya asks Dev to take a dangerous step to secure their future together.

videos.title: Put that gun down, Dev
videos.overview: Dev struggles with the truth while saving himself from being arrested. Kairav makes way for new alliances. Pallavi realises she needs to play the game in order to win. All the pieces come together for the final reveal leading to betrayal and loss.
